title: One photo is all it takes to turn your handwriting into a font
title_candidates: Turning a photo of your handwriting into a real font
One photo is all it takes to turn your handwriting into a font
Custom fonts used to cost thousands, this needs one photo
AI just learned to copy anyone's handwriting from one picture
A developer made a tool that turns handwriting photos into fonts
caption:
A developer built an AI tool that turns one photo of your handwriting into a font you can install on any device. Write the alphabet on paper, snap a picture, and the AI copies every letter into a working font.

Making custom fonts used to take expensive software and design skills. Now it takes a phone camera and a few minutes.
